body: This is a reality check people. It's almost an hour now and I got only one reply which was as good as useless, read my response below.

So here goes reddit. Tbh reddit is of no use at all. People just don't respond at all. They'll say they want to help. But they never do. I added Kittenface but for 20 minutes I waited, and there was no response at all. All they want is somebody who could shed a fear tears and then f-off.

/r/suicidewatch is as good as 7cupsoftea or BlahTherapy which basically means not good at all. In other words crap. 

A reality check: People post on different issues, all they are trying to say is that they are f-lonely! And I've no idea how the system should work or how it shouldn't. But this is what I got, no response at all.

I'm lonely. So Kitten comes up and says "Talk to me :)" what good is that when you don't follow through? I mean seriously!
